comment: Prof G is a bit boring at first, but hilarious if you really listen. If you took Calculus your senior year, this class will probably be easy for you. If you took it your junior year, it may be a bit harder, but still not bad. Quizzes and tests make up 75% of your grade, so make sure to study for each one because she doesn't give any extra credit.

have to disagree with the others on this one. just have to make an effort to come to class and do some studying...sucks, i know, but we are in college kids. confirming meeting times before or after class always worked for me.
